item.title: Bank Statement to CSV: Why Converters Fail and How to Verify
item.description: Converters break on bank statements because PDFs have no table structure. Here is why, plus a five-minute balance-chain check you can run yourself.

item.title: PDF Tools People Actually Search For (and When to Use Them)
item.description: The PDF tools people search for most, what each one does, and the fastest way to merge, split, compress, convert, sign, and OCR a file without paying.
